import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_STATE = (1 << 20) + 5;
    static int n, limit, result;
    static int[] power1 = new int[MAX_STATE];
    static int[] power2 = new int[MAX_STATE];
    static int[][] constraints = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] values = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] tripleMask = new int[10][10][10];

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long modInverse(long x) {
        return modPow(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean isValid(int a, int b, int c) {
        int[] arr = {a, b, c};
        int[] perm = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (constraints[arr[perm[0]]][1] == 1 && 
                constraints[arr[perm[1]]][2] == 1 && 
                constraints[arr[perm[2]]][3] == 1) {
                return true;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(perm));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = array[start];
            array[start] = array[end];
            array[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void firstDFS(int coeff, int row, int col) {
        if (row == 7 && col == 1) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (isValid(i, j, k)) {
                            int x = 1;
                            while (x == i || x == j || x == k) x++;
                            int y = x + 1;
                            while (y == i || y == j || y == k) y++;
                            int z = y + 1;
                            while (z == i || z == j || z == k) z++;
                            state |= tripleMask[x][y][z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            power1[state] = (power1[state] + coeff) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        constraints[row][col] = 1;
        if (col == 3) 
            firstDFS((int)((1L * coeff * values[row][col]) % MOD), row + 1, 1);
        else 
            firstDFS((int)((1L * coeff * values[row][col]) % MOD), row, col + 1);
        constraints[row][col] = 0;
        
        if (col == 3) 
            firstDFS((int)((1L * coeff * (MOD + 1 - values[row][col])) % MOD), row + 1, 1);
        else 
            firstDFS((int)((1L * coeff * (MOD + 1 - values[row][col])) % MOD), row, col + 1);
    }

    static void secondDFS(int coeff, int row, int col) {
        if (row == 7 && col == 4) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (isValid(i, j, k)) {
                            state |= tripleMask[i][j][k];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            power2[state] = (power2[state] + coeff) % MOD;
            result = (result + (int)(1L * power1[limit ^ state] * coeff)) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        constraints[row][col - 3] = 1;
        if (col == 6) 
            secondDFS((int)((1L * coeff * values[row][col]) % MOD), row + 1, 4);
        else 
            secondDFS((int)((1L * coeff * values[row][col]) % MOD), row, col + 1);
        constraints[row][col - 3] = 0;
        
        if (col == 6) 
            secondDFS((int)((1L * coeff * (MOD + 1 - values[row][col])) % MOD), row + 1, 4);
        else 
            secondDFS((int)((1L * coeff * (MOD + 1 - values[row][col])) % MOD), row, col + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                int temp = scanner.nextInt();
                values[i][j] = (int)((1L * temp * modInverse(100)) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            values[i][i] = 1;
        }
        
        int counter = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    tripleMask[i][j][k] = 1 << counter++;
                }
            }
        }
        
        firstDFS(1, 1, 1);
        limit = (1 << 20) - 1;
        
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 20; bit++) {
            for (int state = 0; state <= limit; state++) {
                if ((state >> bit & 1) == 1) {
                    power1[state] = (power1[state] + power1[state ^ (1 << bit)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        secondDFS(1, 1, 4);
        result = (MOD + 1 - result) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
